# react-native-splash-screen-newarch

Native splash screen control for React Native 0.76+ and Expo SDK 52+ projects.

## Documentation

- Overview: https://tomwq.github.io/react-native-splash-screen-newarch/
- Quick start: https://tomwq.github.io/react-native-splash-screen-newarch/guide/getting-started
- Expo config plugin: https://tomwq.github.io/react-native-splash-screen-newarch/guide/expo
- Android setup: https://tomwq.github.io/react-native-splash-screen-newarch/guide/android
- iOS setup: https://tomwq.github.io/react-native-splash-screen-newarch/guide/ios
- Hide transitions: https://tomwq.github.io/react-native-splash-screen-newarch/guide/animations
- Startup performance: https://tomwq.github.io/react-native-splash-screen-newarch/guide/performance
- API reference: https://tomwq.github.io/react-native-splash-screen-newarch/api/
- Troubleshooting: https://tomwq.github.io/react-native-splash-screen-newarch/troubleshooting
- English docs: https://tomwq.github.io/react-native-splash-screen-newarch/en/

## Selection rules

- Expo Go is not supported; use prebuild or a development build.
- Android system mode is the fastest path for a centered logo and solid background.
- Android dialog mode is required for full-screen artwork, custom hide transitions, or show() after startup.
- getStartupMetrics() measures native splash retention, not total cold start or time to interactive.
